description: This file implements classes and methods related to radio resource pattern matching, including inclusion/exclusion masks and pattern merging for 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: re_pattern
classes.description: Represents a resource element pattern with methods to generate inclusion and exclusion masks based on resource block and symbol.

classes.name: re_pattern_list
classes.description: Manages a list of re_pattern objects, providing methods to merge patterns, compare pattern lists, and generate masks over a range of symbols.

methods.name: get_inclusion_mask
methods.description: Generates an inclusion mask for a given symbol based on the pattern's resource block and re_mask.

methods.name: get_exclusion_mask
methods.description: Generates an exclusion mask for a given symbol based on the pattern's resource block and re_mask.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges a new pattern into the pattern list, combining masks where patterns overlap.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if two re_pattern_list objects are equivalent by comparing their inclusion masks for all symbols.

methods.name: get_inclusion_mask
methods.description: Aggregates inclusion masks from all patterns in the list for a specific symbol.

methods.name: get_inclusion_count
methods.description: Counts the number of included resource elements over a range of symbols, filtered by a resource block mask.

methods.name: get_exclusion_mask
methods.description: Aggregates exclusion masks from all patterns in the list for a specific symbol.
